The edited model.safetensors is 432 bytes larger than the base file (1,746,943,032 vs 1,746,942,600 bytes). This is presumably a header/metadata difference; it is unverified until a tensor diff is run.

verification_limits: Retrieved 2026-11-03 through the GitHub REST API and Hugging Face Hub API (public, unauthenticated for HF). No weights, datasets, eval sample files or code were downloaded; the only content read was LICENSE and exp8_math/README.md, the p50c edit manifest.json (logs) and the edited model card README.md.
SHA-256 values of HF files are the LFS object IDs reported by the Hub, not computed locally. Non-LFS files have only git blob SHA-1 (artifact_git_blob_sha1).
Tensor-level SHA-256 values are the authors' published values (manifest.json and the model card agree); they were not recomputed.

A pin is a commit ID, so content at that ID is fixed, but a repository can still be deleted or force-pushed; an operator should mirror approved artifacts to read-only research storage and recompute hashes.
Statements in model cards and READMEs (provenance, re-run results, tensor equivalence) are recorded as claims by their authors, not as verified facts.
